Review Text: These headphones are clear and have decent bass for the price. Another positive aspect is that they do not clamp down on your ears which means you will not suffer as much from overheated/red ears after long periods of use.  It lacks padding on the top headband and does not come with a carry case. But other than that, these will make great gifts to friends and family.

Title: 4.5 stars
Review Text:
Build Quality is stellar for $20.  Cable has a nice texture to it, and they're quite comfortable.  They do make my ears a bit warm due to the material choice, but that's to be expected in this price category.
They do not sound like high-end headphones.  They lack in bass, but clarity is good and the sound is quite well rounded, if a little flat.  That said, it doesn't have an aggressive V shaped audio profile like some cheaper brands, and some might find the flat audio profile to be preferable.  I'd like a bit more rumble, but I believe this is the absolute best any brand can do while selling their product for this price.  Some people have shown their ear-cups to be peeling, and thats probably something to consider when handling these.  Due to their cheaper material (and price), throwing them in a bag with sharp objects and no protection will likely result in tears that get worse overtime in the "fabric".  If you took care of them, they feel like they'd last a long time.  If you don't, they wont.
